areas.title: Files, view, navigation and the shell

capabilities.title: Distance from text, move with text, allow overlap
capabilities.note: DE.Views.ImageSettingsAdvanced.textOverlap and textMove are the two switches beside the distances in their advanced position tab. We author none of the three.

capabilities.title: Align selected objects to each other
capabilities.note: Their Align dropdown offers the six alignments plus an align-to-each-other mode; we have no align command at all.

capabilities.title: Align to page or to margin
capabilities.note: mniAlignToMargin is their second mode. Our position gallery lands an object at a margin cell but there is no align-target switch.

capabilities.title: Alt text on an object

partial.missing: a separate alt-text title field beside the description

capabilities.note: We have a description on a dedicated dialog, on the right-click menu and in the properties panel; they carry title and description.

capabilities.title: Change a shape to a different geometry
capabilities.note: The preset token is set at insert and cannot be swapped afterwards on our side.

capabilities.title: 3-D chart rotation settings
capabilities.note: Their 3-D dialog sets X and Y rotation, perspective, depth, height, autoscale and right-angle axes.

capabilities.title: Edit a chart's data
capabilities.note: Their Edit data opens an embedded spreadsheet editor over the chart's cached data.

capabilities.title: Chart elements — title, legend, labels, gridlines
capabilities.note: Their Chart tab drives title, legend position, data labels and both axes.

capabilities.title: Render an embedded chart

partial.missing: live chart rendering; only the file's own preview image, or a text placeholder, is painted

capabilities.note: A chart in an imported document is modelled as a reference and exports unchanged, so nothing is lost, but the page does not show the real chart.

capabilities.title: Change chart type and style
capabilities.note: cmbChartStyle is the style half.

capabilities.title: Crop a picture by dragging its handles
capabilities.note: Both are direct-manipulation crop sessions with grips and a commit. Ours is reachable from the object bar, the right-click menu and a double-click on a picture.

capabilities.title: Crop to Fit and Crop to Fill
capabilities.note: Their crop menu offers the two automatic fits, and a crop-to-shape mode, beside the manual grips; our crop is manual only.

capabilities.title: Distribute objects horizontally or vertically
capabilities.note: We distribute table rows and columns but nothing distributes drawings.

capabilities.title: Drag out a shape at the size you want
capabilities.note: Crosshair, rubber-band preview matching the picked preset, Shift constrains to a square, a bare click drops the default size.

capabilities.title: Edit a shape's points
capabilities.note: Custom geometry is retained verbatim on import but is not typed, so there is nothing for an editor to move.

capabilities.title: Edit a SmartArt diagram's structure

absent.searched: grep for textpane, promote, demote, changeSmartArt and smartArtLayout across web-apps/apps returned only DE.Views.Navigation promote/demote (the document outline panel); there is no SmartArtSettings view beside ChartSettings/ImageSettings/ShapeSettings/TextArtSettings, and the asc_getFromSmartArt / asc_getFromSmartArtInternal flags only lock toolbar items and route the selection to the shape and paragraph advanced dialogs

capabilities.note: Once inserted, their SmartArt is editable only as formatting on its member shapes and text. Neither product has a text pane, an add-shape or a promote/demote command for a diagram.

capabilities.title: Edit the wrap boundary

partial.missing: any editor that moves a wrap-polygon vertex

capabilities.note: An authored wrap polygon is typed and round-trips and the tight/through contour is honoured; no surface reaches its vertices.

capabilities.title: Flip an object horizontally or vertically
capabilities.note: layout.arrange.flipVertical is the matching row. A top-level text box models no transform and the refusal says so rather than doing nothing.

capabilities.title: Free rotation, by handle or by angle
capabilities.note: Rotation grip with Shift snapping, plus a typed angle field in the properties panel; both go through the same engine call.

capabilities.title: Group objects
capabilities.note: Ctrl or Cmd click builds the multi-object selection, and the engine answers whether the set can be grouped and why not.

capabilities.title: Freehand ink and drawing tools

absent.searched: Common.Views.Draw (txtPen, txtHighlighter, txtEraser) exists in apps/common/main/lib/view/Draw.js, but grep for Common.Views.Draw and lib/view/Draw across apps/ resolves only into apps/pdfeditor; the document editor's Toolbar.js has no Draw tab and its btnDraw control comes from PdfSignDialog.js

capabilities.note: The pen, highlighter and eraser belong to their PDF editor, not to the document editor. Neither product inks in a document.

capabilities.title: Insert a chart
capabilities.note: We have no chart authoring of any kind.

capabilities.title: Insert a picture from a file
capabilities.note: Both take a local file. Ours also accepts a pasted or dropped image through the same insertImageFromBlob path.

capabilities.title: Insert a picture from host storage
capabilities.note: Their From Storage row appears only when the integrator answers the insert-image request, so it is an integration point rather than a licence gate. docs/149 grades the same thing as editorConfig.fileChoiceUrl.

capabilities.title: Insert a picture from a URL
capabilities.note: They ship a URL dialog beside the file picker; we have only the file, clipboard and drop routes.

capabilities.title: Insert a shape from a gallery

partial.missing: the rest of the preset catalogue — 22 presets against their full Lines, Arrows, Flowchart, Callouts and Math sets

capabilities.note: Our gallery offers exactly the presets the engine types, in OOXML tokens, so it grows with the model rather than by hand.

capabilities.title: Insert SmartArt
capabilities.note: Their Insert button renders live previews per layout group; we model a diagram only as a preserved reference.

capabilities.title: Merge shapes (union, subtract, intersect)
capabilities.note: Their merge writes custom geometry, which our model does not type.

capabilities.title: Select several objects at once

partial.missing: any command other than Group acting on the held set

capabilities.note: Our held selection exists only to feed Group; delete, wrap, z-order and position still act on the primary object alone.

capabilities.title: Nudge a floating object with the arrow keys
capabilities.note: Fine and coarse steps on both sides; ours takes Shift for the coarse step.

capabilities.title: Restore a picture to its original size
capabilities.note: The image's natural pixel size is read at insert time but is not kept anywhere a later command could restore it from.

capabilities.title: Picture border and effects

partial.missing: any control that authors a picture border, shadow or other picture effect

capabilities.note: The renderer paints an authored picture frame border, so imported ones survive; nothing in the editor sets one.

capabilities.title: Position gallery (nine cells)
capabilities.note: Word's nine cells, on the object chip and the right-click menu; an in-line object is floated first and the menu says so.

capabilities.title: Position relative to page, margin, column or character

partial.missing: a relative-to chooser and percentage positions; every preset writes relativeFrom margin

capabilities.note: Their advanced dialog picks the reference frame per axis and accepts absolute or percentage offsets; our nine cells are hard-wired to the margin and the panel takes absolute inches only.

capabilities.title: Object properties panel
capabilities.note: The command id is object.properties, resolved through the object. family. It takes exact width, height, left and top in inches as one undoable resize, and is reachable from the object bar, the right-click menu and the command palette.

capabilities.title: Replace a picture's bytes in place
capabilities.note: We can delete and re-insert, which loses the object's size, wrap and position. The engine has no replace-bytes op.

capabilities.title: Reset crop
capabilities.note: Committing a crop session with every inset back at zero does clear the crop, but there is no one-gesture reset from a cropped picture.

capabilities.title: Keep the aspect ratio while resizing
capabilities.note: We match their rule: a picture corner locks by default and Shift is an OR on top, which is what their ResizeTracks does. They also expose a persistent lock toggle in the advanced dialog.

capabilities.title: Resize an object with its handles
capabilities.note: Eight grips, live preview, one commit, and the rotated case maps the drag into the object's own space.

capabilities.title: Rotate 90 degrees left or right
capabilities.note: Both directions are declared commands here; theirs are two toolbar buttons plus the right-click Rotate submenu.

capabilities.title: Save a drawing as a picture file
capabilities.note: Their right-click menu exports the selected drawing; we have no object-level export.

capabilities.title: Insert a screenshot

absent.searched: case-insensitive grep for screenshot across web-apps/apps/documenteditor and web-apps/apps/common/main returned no control, menu item or locale key; the only hit in sdkjs is a source comment in common/Drawings/Format/Path.js

capabilities.note: Word has this; neither ONLYOFFICE nor we do, so it is not a parity gap against them.

capabilities.title: Walk the anchored objects from the keyboard
capabilities.note: object.selectPrevious is the other direction; both are navigation and are ungated here.

capabilities.title: Line arrowheads

partial.missing: any control that chooses an arrowhead style or size

capabilities.note: Arrowheads are typed, painted and round-trip; the editor never writes one.

capabilities.title: Gradient fill

partial.missing: any control that authors or edits a gradient

capabilities.note: Multi-stop linear gradients are typed, painted and round-trip; an imported gradient survives an edit session but cannot be created or changed.

capabilities.title: Shape fill

partial.missing: every fill type but a solid swatch, and any custom colour

capabilities.note: Our menu is No fill plus the standard palette, on both the object bar and the right-click menu. Theirs is a fill-type chooser over solid, gradient, picture, texture, pattern and none.

capabilities.title: Texture, pattern and picture fill
capabilities.note: cmbPattern and the shape panel's picture chooser are their other two; we model none of the three as an authorable fill.

capabilities.title: Shape outline colour and weight

partial.missing: dash style, cap and join type

capabilities.note: We set colour and weight and deliberately inherit the rest so a locally rebuilt stroke cannot discard an authored dash pattern.

capabilities.title: Shape shadow
capabilities.note: They have a shadow toggle plus an adjust dialog for angle, distance, size and transparency.

capabilities.title: Text inside a shape
capabilities.note: Double-click is the gesture and the command is the surface that says the gesture exists. Shape content edits through the same full text pipeline as the body.

capabilities.title: Insert a signature line
capabilities.note: Their signature line requires the desktop shell offline, so a browser session never sees it.

capabilities.title: Alignment guides and snapping while dragging

partial.missing: snapping to other objects, and to the top and bottom margins

capabilities.note: We snap to the left and right text margins and both page centre lines and draw a guide; the top and bottom margins are a stated omission because they need a document walk.

capabilities.title: TextArt / WordArt
capabilities.note: They insert TextArt and give it a settings panel with transform, gradient fill and stroke.

capabilities.title: Text box internal margins, vertical anchor and autofit
capabilities.note: Our properties panel edits the four insets, the vertical anchor, both overflow modes and autofit, and keeps authored autofit scale values it does not expose.

capabilities.title: Insert a text box
capabilities.note: Both insert a floating box whose body takes the ordinary text pipeline.

capabilities.title: Ungroup
capabilities.note: Reaching a shape inside a group follows Word's click-in, Escape-out model on our side.

capabilities.title: Put an object back in line with text
capabilities.note: It rewrites the anchor rather than setting a wrap, which is why it is its own command here.

capabilities.title: Text wrapping modes
capabilities.note: Square, tight, through, top-and-bottom, behind and in-front are offered on the object chip, the right-click menu and the properties panel.

capabilities.title: Bring forward, send backward, to front, to back
capabilities.note: All four are declared rows; an inline object is correctly refused with the engine's own reason because the text flow orders it.

capabilities.title: Insert blank page
capabilities.note: Word's Insert blank page is TWO page breaks in one undoable step. The page break it depends on now ships (`layout.break.page`), so what is left is a command that applies two of them as one action and one undo entry - this row read 'it depends on page breaks, which are also unreachable' and that half is closed.

capabilities.title: Bookmarks
capabilities.note: Create, rename, delete and go to, each one undoable action.

capabilities.title: Page borders

absent.searched: No PageBorders view file in web-apps/apps/documenteditor/main/app/view, no PageBorder localeKey and no PageBorder apiMethod in the snapshot; sdkjs touches pgBorders only in fromToJSON.js serialisation.

capabilities.note: Neither product ships a page-borders dialog although both model the property; we import and export w:pgBorders too.

capabilities.title: Column break
capabilities.note: `insertBreak('column')` had no caller; it is the second row of the same `Breaks` dropdown now, beside the page break, which is where theirs is (`Toolbar.js:2385`).

capabilities.title: Page break
capabilities.note: Both put it on Insert and both bind Ctrl+Enter. Ours is one `Breaks` dropdown on the Insert band plus a `Breaks` submenu in the Insert menu, so it is reachable in the compact chrome where the ribbon is hidden, and the chord is one row in `keymap.mjs` rather than a second path through the editor's key handler (`docs/104` HF-127). Refused outside the body's own block list by the engine, by name.

capabilities.title: Section break (next page, continuous, even, odd)
capabilities.note: All four start types ship: `layout.break.section.continuous`, `evenPage` and `oddPage` are the other three, each its own command and its own row in the same dropdown theirs uses (`Toolbar.js:2372-2380`). Guarded on the EFFECT: the four are inserted into one document and the `sectionType` each wrote is read back out of a normalized-JSON export, so a chrome that sent one start type four times fails.

capabilities.title: Insert caption
capabilities.note: Label, position, exclude label, number format, chapter level and separator, with a live preview of the composed caption.

capabilities.title: Update caption numbers

absent.searched: No caption-update control in the snapshot's controls (only btnContentsUpdate and btnTableFiguresUpdate) and no caption-renumber localeKey under DE.Views.Links.

capabilities.note: Ours exists because deleting a caption deliberately does not renumber; they have no equivalent command.

capabilities.title: Page colour
capabilities.note: We import and round-trip w:background but nothing can set it.

capabilities.title: Columns
capabilities.note: Column count and spacing per section, in the Page setup dialog.

capabilities.title: Unequal column widths

partial.missing: per-column widths and the Left/Right unequal presets

capabilities.note: Our writer always sends equal widths with an empty per-column list; their custom dialog edits each column.

capabilities.title: Content controls / structured document tags
capabilities.note: We import and export w:sdt and refuse breaks inside one, but nothing can insert or configure a control.

capabilities.title: Cross-reference
capabilities.note: Heading, bookmark, footnote, endnote and caption labels, with the per-type reference-to mapping their dialog uses.

capabilities.title: Cross-reference to a numbered item

partial.missing: Numbered item as a reference type

capabilities.note: The engine's referenceTargets has no numbered-paragraph enumeration, so the type is absent rather than present and empty.

capabilities.title: Breadth of the field catalogue

partial.missing: REF, PAGEREF, `SEQ`, `STYLEREF`, NOTEREF, TOC, HYPERLINK and MERGEFIELD as authorable field kinds

capabilities.note: Counted from source: their parser in sdkjs word/Editor/Paragraph/ComplexFieldInstruction.js recognises 17 keywords (PAGE, PAGEREF, TOC, ASC, REF, NOTEREF, NUMPAGES, HYPERLINK, `SEQ`, `STYLEREF`, TIME, DATE, ADDIN, MERGEFIELD, FORMTEXT, FORMCHECKBOX and = for a formula) and falls back to REF for anything else, so about 14 are document field codes. Our picker offers six kinds.

capabilities.title: Date and time field

partial.missing: a format list, a language and an update-automatically switch

capabilities.note: Ours caches one locale-default medium format at insert time.

capabilities.title: Document property fields (file name, author)

absent.searched: Their field-instruction parser handles no FILENAME, AUTHOR, TITLE or DOCPROPERTY keyword — grep for FILENAME, AUTHOR and DOCPROPERTY across sdkjs/word returns nothing — and no such localeKey exists in the snapshot.

capabilities.note: We offer file name and author fields; their parser has no document-property field at all.

capabilities.title: Insert field
capabilities.note: Their generic field button sits on the header and footer tab; their other Insert field is the mail-merge one.

capabilities.title: Toggle field codes

absent.searched: No field-code toggle control or localeKey in the snapshot, and sdkjs has no show-field-codes view mode.

capabilities.note: Neither product lets a reader see the instruction behind a field.

capabilities.title: Update all fields

partial.missing: a document-wide refresh that covers every field kind

absent.searched: The snapshot's only update controls are btnContentsUpdate and btnTableFiguresUpdate; there is no update-all-fields control or localeKey.

capabilities.note: Both products update per field family rather than document-wide; ours covers the table of contents and captions.

capabilities.title: Go to page

partial.missing: typing a page number to jump to it

capabilities.note: Our status bar shows the page indicator but does not accept a number; the Pages panel is the only jump.

capabilities.title: Header and footer distance from edge
Link to previous

partial.missing: the ability to change it — the checkbox ships disabled and read-only

capabilities.note: Our dialog shows what the document says and says why it cannot be changed: unlinking needs a deep copy of the inherited band the engine cannot make (docs/129).

capabilities.title: Remove header or footer
capabilities.note: There is no removeRunningContent binding, so a band that exists can be emptied but not deleted.

capabilities.title: Insert hyperlink
capabilities.note: A real dialog with display text, URL, internal target and ScreenTip.

capabilities.title: Link to a place in this document

partial.missing: linking straight to a heading — only bookmarks are listed

capabilities.note: Auto-bookmarking a heading would be a second undoable op, so a user has to bookmark the heading first.

capabilities.title: Hyphenation
capabilities.note: The model carries w:autoHyphenation and w:hyphenationZone; no control reads or writes them.

capabilities.title: Line numbering

partial.missing: the Apply to choice — whole document or this point forward

capabilities.note: Restart mode, start at, count by and distance all ship; the change is always scoped to the caret's section.

capabilities.title: Mail merge
capabilities.note: Theirs is licence-gated, so a browser session only sees it when the server says so.

capabilities.title: Custom page margins
capabilities.note: Both open a dialog with the four margins; ours is the Page setup dialog opened on the margin fields.

capabilities.title: Gutter

partial.missing: the gutter position control (left or top)

capabilities.note: We set the gutter width; they also choose which edge it sits on.

capabilities.title: Mirrored margins
capabilities.note: Inside and outside margins for two-sided printing. Neither our dialog nor our section writer exposes a mirror flag.

capabilities.title: Margin presets (Normal, Narrow, Moderate, Wide)
capabilities.note: Their Margins button drops a preset list before the custom dialog; ours goes straight to four number fields.

capabilities.title: Promote, demote and add headings from the outline

partial.missing: promote, demote, new heading and select-section from the panel

capabilities.note: Ours navigates only; theirs restructures the document from the panel.

capabilities.title: Navigation pane / outline
capabilities.note: A heading tree that follows the caret.

capabilities.title: Go to next or previous note
capabilities.note: Reading a document with notes means scrolling for them.

capabilities.title: Footnote and endnote settings
capabilities.note: Location, number format, start at and restart each page or section are all unreachable, so imported numbering cannot be changed.

capabilities.title: Page number format
capabilities.note: Five ST_NumberFormat tokens; their sixth (- 1 -) is deliberately out because the layout cannot render it.

capabilities.title: Insert page number
capabilities.note: insert.field.page puts a PAGE field at the caret and has its own Insert-band button; insert.field.numpages is the page-count field.

capabilities.title: Page number position presets
capabilities.note: They offer six top and bottom by left, centre and right placements; ours inserts at the caret only.

capabilities.title: Start page numbering at
capabilities.note: Continue from previous section versus Start at N, the same radio pair as theirs.

capabilities.title: Custom page size
capabilities.note: Width and height in inches in the Page setup dialog.

capabilities.title: Page size presets (A4, Letter, Legal)
capabilities.note: Their size dialog leads with a named paper list; ours has only the two number fields, so a user has to know A4 in inches.

capabilities.title: Table of figures
capabilities.note: We have captions but nothing that collects them into a table.

capabilities.title: Insert text from file
capabilities.note: We can open a document but not merge one into the caret's position.

capabilities.title: Page thumbnails
capabilities.note: Ours renders a window of real page thumbnails around the page being read rather than one per page.

capabilities.title: Add paragraph to table of contents
capabilities.note: Their Add text marks the current paragraph at a chosen contents level without restyling it as a heading.

capabilities.title: Follow a contents entry
capabilities.note: Reachable from the keyboard, from a click and from the right-click menu on our side.

capabilities.title: Insert table of contents
capabilities.note: Checked rather than assumed: the control is no longer disabled-with-a-reason, it runs tocCommands.insert against the engine's insertTableOfContents.

capabilities.title: Table of contents levels
capabilities.note: Show levels 1 to 9 defaulting to 3, matching Word and their settings dialog.

capabilities.title: Remove table of contents
capabilities.note: The field can be inserted and updated but not deleted as a unit.

capabilities.title: Table of contents settings (page numbers, alignment, links)
capabilities.note: Show page numbers, right-align them, hyperlink the entries and build from styles rather than outline levels are all fixed for us.

capabilities.title: Table of contents style gallery
capabilities.note: Their dialog offers Simple, Standard, Modern, Classic and the rest; ours generates one shape.

capabilities.title: Update entire table
capabilities.note: reference.updateFields is the two-radio dialog over these two modes, and it too is live rather than disabled now.

capabilities.title: Vertical alignment of a section

absent.searched: No vAlign or vertical-alignment localeKey under DE.Views in the snapshot and no ApiSection vertical-alignment method in apiMethods; their PageMarginsDialog carries only margins, gutter and mirroring.

capabilities.note: We expose the section's w:vAlign; they do not offer it anywhere in the document editor.

capabilities.title: Picture watermark

partial.missing: the picture half, which ships as a disabled choice carrying its reason

capabilities.note: An imported picture watermark round-trips untouched but cannot be created or edited; there is no way to register a media id.

capabilities.title: Text watermark
capabilities.note: Ours applies to the caret's section rather than to the whole document, which their dialog does.

capabilities.title: Paragraph advanced settings
capabilities.note: Ours is a live side panel (style, alignment, indents, spacing, shading, borders, pagination) that applies on change; theirs is a four-tab modal that also carries font, direction, outline level and tabs.

capabilities.title: Border between paragraphs
capabilities.note: Their border picker has an inner-border button; our preset set covers only the four outer edges.

capabilities.title: Paragraph borders (edge presets)
capabilities.note: We offer none / box / top / bottom / left / right plus a colour picker.

capabilities.title: Paragraph border line style and width

partial.missing: no line-style or width chooser — set_paragraph_border always writes a single line and the UI passes a fixed weight

capabilities.note: Their advanced dialog pairs cmbBorderSize with cmbBorderType; ours has only a colour input beside the edge presets.

capabilities.title: Distance from text for paragraph borders
capabilities.note: BorderEdge carries space_points in our model but the editor never writes it.

capabilities.title: Clear paragraph formatting

partial.missing: clears direct character formatting only — Operation::ClearFormatting leaves alignment, indents, spacing, borders and shading in place

capabilities.note: Their btnClearStyle calls `api.ClearFormating()`, which reaches CDocument.ClearParagraphFormatting and resets paragraph properties as well as run properties.

capabilities.title: Don't add space between paragraphs of the same style
capabilities.note: w:contextualSpacing is modelled, rendered and reported in tracked-change labels on our side, but casual-doc-wasm exposes no setter, so it cannot be authored.

capabilities.title: Right-to-left paragraph direction
capabilities.note: We import, render and round-trip w:bidi and run the Unicode bidi algorithm per line, but there is no way to set a paragraph's base direction from the editor.

capabilities.title: Show non-printing characters
capabilities.note: There is no pilcrow, tab-arrow or space-dot overlay anywhere in our chrome, which makes tab stops and empty paragraphs hard to diagnose while editing.

capabilities.title: Exact left and right indent
capabilities.note: Ours are numeric fields in the paragraph properties panel, reachable from Home and from the Layout tab's Indent button.

capabilities.title: Increase indent
capabilities.note: Both products make this Word's dual-purpose control: inside a list it changes the list level, elsewhere it moves the left indent.

capabilities.title: Drag indent markers on the ruler
capabilities.note: Both draw a horizontal ruler with draggable left, right, first-line and hanging markers.

capabilities.title: First-line and hanging indent
capabilities.note: Same three-way Special control in both: none / first line / hanging with a By amount.

capabilities.title: Line spacing presets
capabilities.note: Our presets are generated from the spacing popover's own markup, so each preset also gets a command id.

capabilities.title: Line spacing rule (multiple / at least / exactly)
Adjust list indents
capabilities.note: Their separate dialog sets the marker position, the text indent and whether a tab, a space or nothing follows the marker.

capabilities.title: Bullet library
capabilities.note: Ours is a six-glyph gallery on the bullet button's split caret; every cell also gets a command id generated from the markup.

capabilities.title: Change list level
capabilities.note: Ours routes through the indent commands and Tab / Shift+Tab, which is Word's behaviour; theirs adds an explicit level submenu on the list buttons.

capabilities.title: Checklist

absent.searched: grep -rniE 'checklist' over reference/web-apps/apps/documenteditor and reference/sdkjs/word — no matches; the closest is the static checkmark bullet glyph behind DE.Views.Toolbar.tipMarkersCheckmark, which is a marker shape and not a tickable item

capabilities.note: We are ahead: toggleList("checklist") produces a real checklist with a toggleable box, reachable from the ribbon and from a command id.

capabilities.title: Custom bullet from a symbol
capabilities.note: We ship a glyph picker for inserting symbols into text but it cannot be used to define a list marker; our bullet gallery is a fixed six.

capabilities.title: Picture bullet
capabilities.note: Their bullet-type combo has image and new-image entries. On our side w:lvlPicBulletId and w:numPicBullet are not modelled at all, so picture bullets are dropped on import as well as unauthorable.

capabilities.title: Multilevel list
capabilities.note: Multi-level numbering imports, renders and round-trips correctly on our side, but there is no gallery to start a multilevel list from scratch. Their button offers a library of chapter, heading and symbol schemes.

capabilities.title: Numbering format library
capabilities.note: Ours offers decimal, lower/upper letter and lower/upper Roman; theirs also groups formats already used in the document.

capabilities.title: Set numbering value
capabilities.note: Our restartList always restarts at 1; there is no way to start a list at an arbitrary number.

capabilities.title: List settings (per-level bullet, number format, alignment)
capabilities.note: Their dialog edits each level's marker type, font, size, colour, start value, alignment and follow character. We have no equivalent; our only list customisation is picking a marker from the two galleries.

capabilities.title: Paragraph outline level
capabilities.note: Outline level is modelled and drives our outline panel, but it can only be set indirectly by applying a heading style; there is no direct level chooser.

capabilities.title: Space before and after a paragraph
capabilities.note: We also expose one-gesture add/remove space rows as the paragraph.space. command family.

capabilities.title: Style gallery and apply style
capabilities.note: Our band ranks the document's own paragraph styles, offering six suggested names before the full list; each style also resolves as a style. command id.

capabilities.title: Create a new style from selection
capabilities.note: Same licence gate. Their StyleTitleDialog also asks for the next-paragraph style, which ours does not.

capabilities.title: Delete a custom style
capabilities.note: Their style gallery's context menu deletes one custom style or all of them; we can create and update styles but never remove one.

capabilities.title: Style for the following paragraph
capabilities.note: w:next is honoured when a document supplies it, but our create-style flow never asks for one.

capabilities.title: Rename a style

absent.searched: grep -rniE 'renameStyle|textRename' over reference/web-apps/apps/documenteditor/main/app/view/Toolbar.js and controller/Toolbar.js — no matches; ls of apps/documenteditor/main/app/view shows StyleTitleDialog.js as the only style dialog and it only names a NEW style

capabilities.note: Neither product can rename an existing style, and neither ships a Word-style style manager.

capabilities.title: Restore a built-in style to its default
capabilities.note: Undoing an over-eager Update style is only possible through undo on our side.

capabilities.title: Update style from selection
capabilities.note: canEditStyles is canLicense && canEdit in apps/documenteditor/main/app/controller/Main.js:1733, so a browser session without a licence result never sees their style menu. Ours is ungated.

capabilities.title: Suppress line numbers for this paragraph

capabilities.title: Border width and line style

partial.missing: line style, in the CHROME only. The engine argument landed: `border_edge` takes a style, `setCellBorder` takes an optional `style` of six tokens and refuses a seventh, and `cellBorderStyle` reads one back, so dashed, dotted and double are authorable through the facade today. What is missing is a control that sends one - no ribbon, menu, context-menu or palette surface offers the style, so the capability is unreachable for a user. Graded a gap for that reason and no other.

capabilities.note: WIDTH now ships, and it is their whole anchor: `cmbBorderSize` offers seven widths and no style, and their advanced table dialog is the same control again. Ours is one pen for the cell presets and the table presets together, which is Word's shape, and it defaults to half a point - the value Word, their `TableSettings` and our own `insertTable` already used, where the chrome used to send one point and silently double the gridlines it had just drawn. Guarded on the EFFECT rather than the control: the width is read back out of a real normalized-JSON export, because the only border read-back the facade offers is a presence bitmask.
